turns.query: In October 2025, for all general air quality stations combined, group hourly PM2.5/PM10 ratios by humidity bins from the King's Park weather station: low (<60%), medium (60-80%), high (>80%). Compute the average PM2.5/PM10 ratio for each bin (only include hours where both PM2.5 and PM10 are valid and PM10 > 0). Return the three ratios rounded to 3 decimal places.
code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Time window: whole October 2025, start-inclusive/end-exclusive
october2025_start_ts = "2025-10-01 00:00:00"
october2025_end_ts = "2025-11-01 00:00:00"

# Resolve all GENERAL air quality stations by authoritative station_type category
general_air_quality_stations_df = pd.read_sql(text("""
    SELECT id, name_en, station_type
    FROM air_quality_station
    WHERE station_type = 'GENERAL'
    ORDER BY id
"""), engine)
general_air_quality_station_ids = general_air_quality_stations_df["id"].astype(int).tolist()
print(f"RESOLVED: all general air quality stations = {general_air_quality_station_ids}")
print(f"general_air_quality_stations_df row_count = {len(general_air_quality_stations_df)}")

# Resolve King's Park weather station: exact-name equality first, then one fuzzy fallback
weather_station_name_kings_park = "King's Park"
weather_station_kings_park_exact_df = pd.read_sql(
    text("""
        SELECT id, name_en, station_code
        FROM weather_station
        WHERE name_en = :name
        ORDER BY id
        LIMIT 5
    """),
    engine,
    params={"name": weather_station_name_kings_park}
)
if len(weather_station_kings_park_exact_df) > 0:
    weather_station_kings_park_df = weather_station_kings_park_exact_df
else:
    weather_station_kings_park_df = pd.read_sql(
        text("""
            SELECT id, name_en, station_code
            FROM weather_station
            WHERE name_en ILIKE :pattern
            ORDER BY CASE WHEN name_en ILIKE :prefix THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, id
            LIMIT 5
        """),
        engine,
        params={"pattern": "%King%Park%", "prefix": "King%Park%"}
    )

if len(weather_station_kings_park_df) > 0:
    weather_station_id_kings_park = int(weather_station_kings_park_df.iloc[0]["id"])
    print(f"RESOLVED: King's Park weather station = {weather_station_id_kings_park}")
else:
    weather_station_id_kings_park = None
    print("UNRESOLVED: King's Park weather station")

# Domain knowledge notes needed for interpretation and filtering
pm_units_note = "PM2.5 and PM10 concentrations are in micrograms per cubic metre (µg/m³)."
relative_humidity_units_note = "Relative humidity is reported as percent (%)."
pm_ratio_interpretation_note = "PM2.5/PM10 is unitless because both pollutants use the same concentration units."
validity_flags_note = "No source validity-flag fields are available in the provided hourly air-quality/weather schema; analysts should treat non-null positive PM10 and non-null PM2.5/humidity as minimum usability checks."
humidity_bins_note = "Requested downstream bins: low <60%, mid 60-80%, high >80% relative humidity."
print(f"DOMAIN_NOTE: {pm_units_note}")
print(f"DOMAIN_NOTE: {relative_humidity_units_note}")
print(f"DOMAIN_NOTE: {pm_ratio_interpretation_note}")
print(f"DOMAIN_NOTE: {validity_flags_note}")
print(f"DOMAIN_NOTE: {humidity_bins_note}")

# Pre-count expected large fetches before loading hourly records
if general_air_quality_station_ids:
    pm_count_df = pd.read_sql(
        text("""
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
                   COUNT(pm2_5) AS n_pm2_5,
                   COUNT(pm10) AS n_pm10
            FROM hourly_station_air_quality
            WHERE station_id = ANY(:station_ids)
              AND datetime >= :start_ts
              AND datetime < :end_ts
        """),
        engine,
        params={"station_ids": general_air_quality_station_ids, "start_ts": october2025_start_ts, "end_ts": october2025_end_ts}
    )
    print(f"PM prefetch count rows = {int(pm_count_df.loc[0, 'n_rows'])}; non_null_pm2_5 = {int(pm_count_df.loc[0, 'n_pm2_5'])}; non_null_pm10 = {int(pm_count_df.loc[0, 'n_pm10'])}")
else:
    pm_count_df = pd.DataFrame()
    print("PM prefetch count skipped: no resolved general air quality station ids")

if weather_station_id_kings_park is not None:
    rh_count_df = pd.read_sql(
        text("""
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
                   COUNT(humidity) AS n_humidity
            FROM hourly_station_weather
            WHERE station_id = :station_id
              AND datetime >= :start_ts
              AND datetime < :end_ts
        """),
        engine,
        params={"station_id": weather_station_id_kings_park, "start_ts": october2025_start_ts, "end_ts": october2025_end_ts}
    )
    print(f"RH prefetch count rows = {int(rh_count_df.loc[0, 'n_rows'])}; non_null_humidity = {int(rh_count_df.loc[0, 'n_humidity'])}")
else:
    rh_count_df = pd.DataFrame()
    print("RH prefetch count skipped: King's Park weather station unresolved")

# Fetch October 2025 hourly PM2.5/PM10 for all general AQ stations
if general_air_quality_station_ids and int(pm_count_df.loc[0, "n_rows"]) > 0:
    october2025_general_pm_hourly_df = pd.read_sql(
        text("""
            SELECT h.station_id,
                   s.name_en AS station_name,
                   h.datetime,
                   h.pm2_5,
                   h.pm10,
                   CASE WHEN h.pm2_5 IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS pm2_5_present_flag,
                   CASE WHEN h.pm10 IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS pm10_present_flag,
                   CASE WHEN h.pm10 IS NOT NULL AND h.pm10 > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS pm10_positive_flag,
                   'µg/m³' AS pm_unit
            FROM hourly_station_air_quality h
            JOIN air_quality_station s ON s.id = h.station_id
            WHERE h.station_id = ANY(:station_ids)
              AND h.datetime >= :start_ts
              AND h.datetime < :end_ts
            ORDER BY h.datetime, h.station_id
        """),
        engine,
        params={"station_ids": general_air_quality_station_ids, "start_ts": october2025_start_ts, "end_ts": october2025_end_ts}
    )
else:
    # Re-check station resolution summary rather than silently passing an expected empty fetch downstream
    october2025_general_pm_hourly_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=["station_id", "station_name", "datetime", "pm2_5", "pm10", "pm2_5_present_flag", "pm10_present_flag", "pm10_positive_flag", "pm_unit"])
    print("EMPTY_FETCH_RECHECK: October 2025 PM data empty or no GENERAL station ids; verify station_type resolution above.")
print(f"october2025_general_pm_hourly_df row_count = {len(october2025_general_pm_hourly_df)}")

# Fetch October 2025 hourly relative humidity at King's Park
if weather_station_id_kings_park is not None and int(rh_count_df.loc[0, "n_rows"]) > 0:
    october2025_kings_park_humidity_hourly_df = pd.read_sql(
        text("""
            SELECT station_id,
                   datetime,
                   humidity,
                   CASE WHEN humidity IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS humidity_present_flag,
                   '%' AS humidity_unit
            FROM hourly_station_weather
            WHERE station_id = :station_id
              AND datetime >= :start_ts
              AND datetime < :end_ts
            ORDER BY datetime
        """),
        engine,
        params={"station_id": weather_station_id_kings_park, "start_ts": october2025_start_ts, "end_ts": october2025_end_ts}
    )
else:
    october2025_kings_park_humidity_hourly_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=["station_id", "datetime", "humidity", "humidity_present_flag", "humidity_unit"])
    print("EMPTY_FETCH_RECHECK: October 2025 King's Park humidity data empty or station unresolved; verify weather station resolution above.")
print(f"october2025_kings_park_humidity_hourly_df row_count = {len(october2025_kings_park_humidity_hourly_df)}")

# Compact quality summaries for analysts, without printing raw records
if len(october2025_general_pm_hourly_df) > 0:
    pm_quality_summary_df = october2025_general_pm_hourly_df.groupby("station_id").agg(
        station_name=("station_name", "first"),
        rows=("datetime", "count"),
        pm2_5_non_null=("pm2_5", lambda x: int(x.notna().sum())),
        pm10_non_null=("pm10", lambda x: int(x.notna().sum())),
        pm10_positive=("pm10_positive_flag", lambda x: int(x.sum()))
    ).reset_index()
    print("PM quality summary by station:")
    print(pm_quality_summary_df.to_string(index=False))
else:
    pm_quality_summary_df = pd.DataFrame()

if len(october2025_kings_park_humidity_hourly_df) > 0:
    humidity_quality_summary_df = pd.DataFrame([{
        "station_id": weather_station_id_kings_park,
        "rows": int(len(october2025_kings_park_humidity_hourly_df)),
        "humidity_non_null": int(october2025_kings_park_humidity_hourly_df["humidity"].notna().sum()),
        "humidity_min": float(october2025_kings_park_humidity_hourly_df["humidity"].min()),
        "humidity_max": float(october2025_kings_park_humidity_hourly_df["humidity"].max())
    }])
    print("Humidity quality summary:")
    print(humidity_quality_summary_df.to_string(index=False))
else:
    humidity_quality_summary_df = pd.DataFrame()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Reuse staged October 2025 hourly PM and King's Park humidity datasets; do not re-query.
pm_src = october2025_general_pm_hourly_df.copy()
rh_src = october2025_kings_park_humidity_hourly_df.copy()

# Standardize datetime columns defensively without altering staged source variables.
pm_time_col = 'datetime' if 'datetime' in pm_src.columns else ('timestamp' if 'timestamp' in pm_src.columns else None)
rh_time_col = 'datetime' if 'datetime' in rh_src.columns else ('timestamp' if 'timestamp' in rh_src.columns else None)
if pm_time_col is None or rh_time_col is None:
    raise ValueError("A datetime/timestamp column is missing from the staged PM or humidity dataset.")

required_pm_cols = {'station_id', 'pm2_5', 'pm10'}
missing_pm_cols = required_pm_cols - set(pm_src.columns)
if missing_pm_cols:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing required PM columns in staged dataset: {sorted(missing_pm_cols)}")
if 'humidity' not in rh_src.columns:
    raise ValueError("Missing humidity column in staged King's Park humidity dataset.")

pm_work = pm_src[['station_id', pm_time_col, 'pm2_5', 'pm10']].rename(columns={pm_time_col: 'aligned_datetime'}).copy()
rh_work = rh_src[[rh_time_col, 'humidity']].rename(columns={rh_time_col: 'aligned_datetime', 'humidity': 'kings_park_humidity'}).copy()
pm_work['aligned_datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(pm_work['aligned_datetime']).dt.floor('h')
rh_work['aligned_datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(rh_work['aligned_datetime']).dt.floor('h')

# If humidity has more than one record per hour, use the hourly mean so each station-hour aligns to one humidity value.
spatial_agent_kings_park_humidity_hourly_mean_df = (
    rh_work.dropna(subset=['kings_park_humidity'])
           .groupby('aligned_datetime', as_index=False)['kings_park_humidity'].mean()
)

# Valid pollutant records for PM2.5/PM10 ratio: both PM fields present and PM10 > 0.
pm_work['spatial_agent_pm_ratio'] = pm_work['pm2_5'] / pm_work['pm10']
spatial_agent_valid_pm_ratio_records_df = pm_work[
    pm_work['pm2_5'].notna() & pm_work['pm10'].notna() & (pm_work['pm10'] > 0) &
    np.isfinite(pm_work['spatial_agent_pm_ratio'])
].copy()

# Align King's Park hourly humidity to every valid station-hour pollutant record.
spatial_agent_pm_humidity_aligned_records_df = spatial_agent_valid_pm_ratio_records_df.merge(
    spatial_agent_kings_park_humidity_hourly_mean_df,
    on='aligned_datetime',
    how='left'
)

# Assign requested humidity bins; medium includes 60% and 80%, high is strictly >80%.
spatial_agent_pm_humidity_aligned_records_df['spatial_agent_humidity_bin'] = pd.cut(
    spatial_agent_pm_humidity_aligned_records_df['kings_park_humidity'],
    bins=[-np.inf, 60, 80, np.inf],
    labels=['low', 'medium', 'high'],
    right=True
)
spatial_agent_pm_humidity_aligned_records_df.loc[
    spatial_agent_pm_humidity_aligned_records_df['kings_park_humidity'] < 60,
    'spatial_agent_humidity_bin'
] = 'low'

# Retain only records that have aligned humidity for bin-level statistics/correlation.
spatial_agent_pm_humidity_binned_records_df = spatial_agent_pm_humidity_aligned_records_df.dropna(
    subset=['kings_park_humidity', 'spatial_agent_humidity_bin', 'spatial_agent_pm_ratio']
).copy()

spatial_agent_humidity_alignment_summary_df = pd.DataFrame([{
    'valid_pm_station_hour_records': int(len(spatial_agent_valid_pm_ratio_records_df)),
    'records_with_aligned_humidity': int(len(spatial_agent_pm_humidity_binned_records_df)),
    'records_missing_aligned_humidity': int(spatial_agent_pm_humidity_aligned_records_df['kings_park_humidity'].isna().sum()),
    'unique_pollutant_hours': int(spatial_agent_valid_pm_ratio_records_df['aligned_datetime'].nunique()),
    'unique_humidity_hours_available': int(spatial_agent_kings_park_humidity_hourly_mean_df['aligned_datetime'].nunique())
}])

spatial_agent_humidity_bin_ratio_stats_df = (
    spatial_agent_pm_humidity_binned_records_df
    .groupby('spatial_agent_humidity_bin', observed=False)
    .agg(
        station_hour_records=('spatial_agent_pm_ratio', 'size'),
        mean_pm25_pm10_ratio=('spatial_agent_pm_ratio', 'mean'),
        mean_humidity=('kings_park_humidity', 'mean')
    )
    .reset_index()
)

spatial_agent_humidity_ratio_correlation_value = (
    float(spatial_agent_pm_humidity_binned_records_df['kings_park_humidity'].corr(
        spatial_agent_pm_humidity_binned_records_df['spatial_agent_pm_ratio'],
        method='pearson'
    ))
    if len(spatial_agent_pm_humidity_binned_records_df) >= 2 else np.nan
)

print("Alignment summary:")
print(spatial_agent_humidity_alignment_summary_df.to_string(index=False))
print("\nHumidity-bin PM2.5/PM10 ratio statistics:")
print(spatial_agent_humidity_bin_ratio_stats_df.round({'mean_pm25_pm10_ratio': 6, 'mean_humidity': 3}).to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nPearson humidity-ratio correlation (unrounded): {spatial_agent_humidity_ratio_correlation_value}")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Reuse the already staged alignment/statistics outputs; do not re-query or overwrite required output variables.
stats_agent_source_ratio_stats_df = spatial_agent_humidity_bin_ratio_stats_df.copy()
stats_agent_source_correlation_value = float(spatial_agent_humidity_ratio_correlation_value) if pd.notna(spatial_agent_humidity_ratio_correlation_value) else np.nan

# Identify bin and mean-ratio columns from the staged aggregate table.
_cols = list(stats_agent_source_ratio_stats_df.columns)
_bin_col_candidates = [c for c in _cols if "bin" in str(c).lower()]
_mean_ratio_col_candidates = [c for c in _cols if ("ratio" in str(c).lower() and ("mean" in str(c).lower() or "avg" in str(c).lower()))]
if not _mean_ratio_col_candidates:
    _mean_ratio_col_candidates = [c for c in _cols if "ratio" in str(c).lower() and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(stats_agent_source_ratio_stats_df[c])]

stats_agent_humidity_bin_column_used = _bin_col_candidates[0] if _bin_col_candidates else None
stats_agent_mean_ratio_column_used = _mean_ratio_col_candidates[0] if _mean_ratio_col_candidates else None

if stats_agent_humidity_bin_column_used is None or stats_agent_mean_ratio_column_used is None:
    raise ValueError(f"Could not identify humidity-bin and mean-ratio columns in staged stats. Columns available: {_cols}")

# Normalize bin labels to the three requested bins and store rounded values for synthesis agent.
_stats_tmp = stats_agent_source_ratio_stats_df[[stats_agent_humidity_bin_column_used, stats_agent_mean_ratio_column_used]].copy()
_stats_tmp.columns = ["humidity_bin_label", "mean_pm25_pm10_ratio"]
_stats_tmp["humidity_bin_label_norm"] = _stats_tmp["humidity_bin_label"].astype(str).str.lower()

def _requested_bin(label):
    if ("low" in label) or ("<" in label and "60" in label) or ("below" in label and "60" in label):
        return "low_humidity"
    if ("mid" in label) or ("60" in label and "80" in label) or ("moderate" in label):
        return "mid_humidity"
    if ("high" in label) or (">" in label and "80" in label) or ("above" in label and "80" in label):
        return "high_humidity"
    return None

_stats_tmp["requested_humidity_bin"] = _stats_tmp["humidity_bin_label_norm"].map(_requested_bin)
stats_agent_humidity_bin_mean_ratios_unrounded_df = _stats_tmp.dropna(subset=["requested_humidity_bin"])[
    ["requested_humidity_bin", "mean_pm25_pm10_ratio"]
].copy()
stats_agent_humidity_bin_mean_ratios_rounded_df = stats_agent_humidity_bin_mean_ratios_unrounded_df.copy()
stats_agent_humidity_bin_mean_ratios_rounded_df["mean_pm25_pm10_ratio_3dp"] = (
    stats_agent_humidity_bin_mean_ratios_rounded_df["mean_pm25_pm10_ratio"].astype(float).round(3)
)

stats_agent_low_humidity_ratio_3dp = float(
    stats_agent_humidity_bin_mean_ratios_rounded_df.loc[
        stats_agent_humidity_bin_mean_ratios_rounded_df["requested_humidity_bin"].eq("low_humidity"),
        "mean_pm25_pm10_ratio_3dp"
    ].iloc[0]
) if (stats_agent_humidity_bin_mean_ratios_rounded_df["requested_humidity_bin"].eq("low_humidity")).any() else np.nan

stats_agent_mid_humidity_ratio_3dp = float(
    stats_agent_humidity_bin_mean_ratios_rounded_df.loc[
        stats_agent_humidity_bin_mean_ratios_rounded_df["requested_humidity_bin"].eq("mid_humidity"),
        "mean_pm25_pm10_ratio_3dp"
    ].iloc[0]
) if (stats_agent_humidity_bin_mean_ratios_rounded_df["requested_humidity_bin"].eq("mid_humidity")).any() else np.nan

stats_agent_high_humidity_ratio_3dp = float(
    stats_agent_humidity_bin_mean_ratios_rounded_df.loc[
        stats_agent_humidity_bin_mean_ratios_rounded_df["requested_humidity_bin"].eq("high_humidity"),
        "mean_pm25_pm10_ratio_3dp"
    ].iloc[0]
) if (stats_agent_humidity_bin_mean_ratios_rounded_df["requested_humidity_bin"].eq("high_humidity")).any() else np.nan

stats_agent_humidity_ratio_correlation_4dp = round(stats_agent_source_correlation_value, 4) if pd.notna(stats_agent_source_correlation_value) else np.nan

# Also stage compact dict for synthesis agent.
stats_agent_requested_results_for_synthesis = {
    "ratio_low_humidity_3dp": stats_agent_low_humidity_ratio_3dp,
    "ratio_mid_humidity_3dp": stats_agent_mid_humidity_ratio_3dp,
    "ratio_high_humidity_3dp": stats_agent_high_humidity_ratio_3dp,
    "humidity_ratio_correlation_4dp": stats_agent_humidity_ratio_correlation_4dp,
}

print("Staged rounded PM2.5/PM10 ratio means by humidity bin:")
print(stats_agent_humidity_bin_mean_ratios_rounded_df[["requested_humidity_bin", "mean_pm25_pm10_ratio_3dp"]].to_string(index=False))
print(f"Staged rounded Pearson correlation: {stats_agent_humidity_ratio_correlation_4dp}")
print(f"Columns used: bin='{stats_agent_humidity_bin_column_used}', mean ratio='{stats_agent_mean_ratio_column_used}'")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Compute directly from staged aligned valid records to verify all requested bins, without assigning required output variables.
stats_agent_aligned_records_for_ratio_df = spatial_agent_pm_humidity_aligned_records_df.copy()

# Identify needed columns conservatively from staged aligned data.
_cols = list(stats_agent_aligned_records_for_ratio_df.columns)
_pm25_candidates = [c for c in _cols if str(c).lower() in ["pm2_5", "pm25", "pm2.5"] or "pm2_5" in str(c).lower() or "pm25" in str(c).lower()]
_pm10_candidates = [c for c in _cols if str(c).lower() == "pm10" or "pm10" in str(c).lower()]
_humidity_candidates = [c for c in _cols if "humidity" in str(c).lower() or str(c).lower() in ["rh", "relative_humidity"]]
_ratio_candidates = [c for c in _cols if "ratio" in str(c).lower() and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(stats_agent_aligned_records_for_ratio_df[c])]

stats_agent_direct_pm25_column_used = _pm25_candidates[0] if _pm25_candidates else None
stats_agent_direct_pm10_column_used = _pm10_candidates[0] if _pm10_candidates else None
stats_agent_direct_humidity_column_used = _humidity_candidates[0] if _humidity_candidates else None
stats_agent_direct_existing_ratio_column_used = _ratio_candidates[0] if _ratio_candidates else None

stats_agent_direct_work_df = stats_agent_aligned_records_for_ratio_df.copy()

if stats_agent_direct_humidity_column_used is None:
    raise ValueError(f"Could not identify humidity column. Columns available: {_cols}")

if stats_agent_direct_pm25_column_used is not None and stats_agent_direct_pm10_column_used is not None:
    stats_agent_direct_valid_ratio_records_df = stats_agent_direct_work_df[
        stats_agent_direct_work_df[stats_agent_direct_pm25_column_used].notna()
        & stats_agent_direct_work_df[stats_agent_direct_pm10_column_used].notna()
        & (stats_agent_direct_work_df[stats_agent_direct_pm10_column_used] > 0)
        & stats_agent_direct_work_df[stats_agent_direct_humidity_column_used].notna()
    ].copy()
    stats_agent_direct_valid_ratio_records_df["stats_agent_pm25_pm10_ratio"] = (
        stats_agent_direct_valid_ratio_records_df[stats_agent_direct_pm25_column_used]
        / stats_agent_direct_valid_ratio_records_df[stats_agent_direct_pm10_column_used]
    )
else:
    if stats_agent_direct_existing_ratio_column_used is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not identify PM columns or existing ratio column. Columns available: {_cols}")
    stats_agent_direct_valid_ratio_records_df = stats_agent_direct_work_df[
        stats_agent_direct_work_df[stats_agent_direct_existing_ratio_column_used].notna()
        & stats_agent_direct_work_df[stats_agent_direct_humidity_column_used].notna()
    ].copy()
    stats_agent_direct_valid_ratio_records_df["stats_agent_pm25_pm10_ratio"] = stats_agent_direct_valid_ratio_records_df[stats_agent_direct_existing_ratio_column_used]

_h = stats_agent_direct_valid_ratio_records_df[stats_agent_direct_humidity_column_used].astype(float)
stats_agent_direct_valid_ratio_records_df["stats_agent_humidity_bin"] = np.select(
    [_h < 60, (_h >= 60) & (_h <= 80), _h > 80],
    ["low_humidity", "mid_humidity", "high_humidity"],
    default=np.nan
)

stats_agent_direct_bin_ratio_stats_df = (
    stats_agent_direct_valid_ratio_records_df
    .dropna(subset=["stats_agent_humidity_bin"])
    .groupby("stats_agent_humidity_bin", as_index=False)
    .agg(
        stats_agent_record_count=("stats_agent_pm25_pm10_ratio", "size"),
        stats_agent_mean_pm25_pm10_ratio=("stats_agent_pm25_pm10_ratio", "mean"),
        stats_agent_mean_humidity=(stats_agent_direct_humidity_column_used, "mean")
    )
)
stats_agent_direct_bin_ratio_stats_df["stats_agent_mean_pm25_pm10_ratio_3dp"] = (
    stats_agent_direct_bin_ratio_stats_df["stats_agent_mean_pm25_pm10_ratio"].round(3)
)

stats_agent_direct_humidity_ratio_correlation_unrounded = (
    stats_agent_direct_valid_ratio_records_df[[stats_agent_direct_humidity_column_used, "stats_agent_pm25_pm10_ratio"]]
    .astype(float)
    .corr(method="pearson")
    .iloc[0, 1]
)
stats_agent_direct_humidity_ratio_correlation_4dp = round(float(stats_agent_direct_humidity_ratio_correlation_unrounded), 4)

import pandas as pd

# Fresh independent verification query for October 2025, general AQ stations, King's Park humidity.
query = text("""
WITH kp_candidates AS (
    SELECT id, name_en
    FROM weather_station
    WHERE lower(name_en) LIKE '%king%' AND lower(name_en) LIKE '%park%'
),
kp AS (
    SELECT id, name_en
    FROM kp_candidates
    WHERE name_en = 'King''s Park'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id, name_en
    FROM kp_candidates
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kp_candidates WHERE name_en = 'King''s Park')
    ORDER BY name_en
    LIMIT 1
),
valid_records AS (
    SELECT
        a.datetime,
        a.station_id,
        w.humidity,
        (a.pm2_5 / a.pm10) AS ratio,
        CASE
            WHEN w.humidity < 60 THEN 'low'
            WHEN w.humidity >= 60 AND w.humidity <= 80 THEN 'mid'
            WHEN w.humidity > 80 THEN 'high'
        END AS humidity_bin
    FROM hourly_station_air_quality a
    JOIN air_quality_station s ON s.id = a.station_id
    JOIN kp ON TRUE
    JOIN hourly_station_weather w
      ON w.station_id = kp.id
     AND w.datetime = a.datetime
    WHERE s.station_type = 'GENERAL'
      AND a.datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
      AND a.datetime <  TIMESTAMP '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
      AND a.pm2_5 IS NOT NULL
      AND a.pm10 IS NOT NULL
      AND a.pm10 > 0
      AND w.humidity IS NOT NULL
),
bin_stats AS (
    SELECT humidity_bin, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM valid_records
    WHERE humidity_bin IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY humidity_bin
),
corr_stat AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_corr, CORR(humidity, ratio) AS corr_value
    FROM valid_records
    WHERE humidity_bin IS NOT NULL
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT string_agg(id::text || ':' || name_en, ', ' ORDER BY id) FROM kp_candidates) AS kp_candidates,
        (SELECT id::text || ':' || name_en FROM kp) AS kp_selected,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM air_quality_station WHERE station_type = 'GENERAL') AS general_station_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) FROM valid_records WHERE humidity_bin IS NOT NULL) AS contributing_general_station_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT datetime) FROM valid_records WHERE humidity_bin IS NOT NULL) AS contributing_hour_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM valid_records WHERE humidity_bin IS NOT NULL) AS valid_station_hour_records
)
SELECT
    'BIN' AS row_type,
    humidity_bin,
    n,
    avg_ratio,
    NULL::double precision AS corr_value,
    NULL::text AS kp_candidates,
    NULL::text AS kp_selected,
    NULL::bigint AS general_station_count,
    NULL::bigint AS contributing_general_station_count,
    NULL::bigint AS contributing_hour_count,
    NULL::bigint AS valid_station_hour_records
FROM bin_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'CORR' AS row_type,
    NULL AS humidity_bin,
    n_corr AS n,
    NULL::double precision AS avg_ratio,
    corr_value,
    NULL::text AS kp_candidates,
    NULL::text AS kp_selected,
    NULL::bigint AS general_station_count,
    NULL::bigint AS contributing_general_station_count,
    NULL::bigint AS contributing_hour_count,
    NULL::bigint AS valid_station_hour_records
FROM corr_stat
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'SUMMARY' AS row_type,
    NULL AS humidity_bin,
    NULL::bigint AS n,
    NULL::double precision AS avg_ratio,
    NULL::double precision AS corr_value,
    kp_candidates,
    kp_selected,
    general_station_count,
    contributing_general_station_count,
    contributing_hour_count,
    valid_station_hour_records
FROM summary
ORDER BY row_type, humidity_bin;
""")

df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)

summary = df[df["row_type"] == "SUMMARY"].iloc[0]
bins = df[df["row_type"] == "BIN"].set_index("humidity_bin")
corr_row = df[df["row_type"] == "CORR"].iloc[0]

old_low = ratio_low_humidity

ratio_low_humidity = ind_low

humidity_ratio_correlation = ind_corr

print(f"General stations={int(summary['general_station_count'])} | contributing stations={int(summary['contributing_general_station_count'])} | contributing hours={int(summary['contributing_hour_count'])} | valid station-hour records={int(summary['valid_station_hour_records'])}")

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text
import numpy as np

# Independent verification from raw hourly readings:
# - October 2025: [2025-10-01 00:00, 2025-11-01 00:00)
# - King's Park humidity matched by exact hour
# - Network-wide hourly PM ratio = mean across GENERAL air-quality stations of (PM2.5 / PM10), requiring PM10 > 0 and both PM values non-null
# - Humidity bins: low <60, mid 60-80 inclusive, high >80
q = text("""
WITH kp AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM weather_station
    WHERE lower(name_en) = lower('King''s Park')
    LIMIT 1
),
hourly_ratio AS (
    SELECT
        h.datetime,
        AVG(h.pm2_5 / h.pm10) AS network_avg_pm_ratio,
        COUNT(*) AS station_count
    FROM hourly_station_air_quality h
    JOIN air_quality_station s ON s.id = h.station_id
    WHERE s.station_type = 'GENERAL'
      AND h.datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
      AND h.datetime <  TIMESTAMP '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
      AND h.pm2_5 IS NOT NULL
      AND h.pm10 IS NOT NULL
      AND h.pm10 > 0
    GROUP BY h.datetime
),
matched AS (
    SELECT
        r.datetime,
        w.humidity,
        r.network_avg_pm_ratio
    FROM hourly_ratio r
    JOIN hourly_station_weather w
      ON w.datetime = r.datetime
    JOIN kp ON kp.id = w.station_id
    WHERE w.humidity IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS matched_hours,
        MIN(datetime) AS first_hour,
        MAX(datetime) AS last_hour,
        MIN(humidity) AS min_humidity,
        MAX(humidity) AS max_humidity,
        AVG(humidity) AS avg_humidity,
        MIN(network_avg_pm_ratio) AS min_ratio,
        MAX(network_avg_pm_ratio) AS max_ratio,
        AVG(network_avg_pm_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
        CORR(humidity, network_avg_pm_ratio) AS corr
    FROM matched
),
bins AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN humidity < 60 THEN 'low'
            WHEN humidity <= 80 THEN 'mid'
            ELSE 'high'
        END AS bin,
        COUNT(*) AS n,
        AVG(network_avg_pm_ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM matched
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    'summary' AS row_type,
    NULL::text AS bin,
    matched_hours AS n,
    first_hour,
    last_hour,
    min_humidity,
    max_humidity,
    avg_humidity,
    min_ratio,
    max_ratio,
    avg_ratio,
    corr
FROM agg
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'bin' AS row_type,
    bin,
    n,
    NULL::timestamp,
    NULL::timestamp,
    NULL::double precision,
    NULL::double precision,
    NULL::double precision,
    NULL::double precision,
    NULL::double precision,
    avg_ratio,
    NULL::double precision
FROM bins
ORDER BY row_type DESC, bin
""")

res = pd.read_sql(q, engine)
summary = res[res["row_type"] == "summary"].iloc[0]
bin_df = res[res["row_type"] == "bin"].set_index("bin")

ind_low = round(float(bin_df.loc["low", "avg_ratio"]), 3) if "low" in bin_df.index else float("nan")
ind_mid = round(float(bin_df.loc["mid", "avg_ratio"]), 3) if "mid" in bin_df.index else float("nan")
ind_high = round(float(bin_df.loc["high", "avg_ratio"]), 3) if "high" in bin_df.index else float("nan")
ind_corr = round(float(summary["corr"]), 4)

old_low = ratio_low_humidity
old_mid = ratio_mid_humidity
old_high = ratio_high_humidity
old_corr = humidity_ratio_correlation

ratio_low_humidity = ind_low
ratio_mid_humidity = ind_mid
ratio_high_humidity = ind_high
humidity_ratio_correlation = ind_corr

print("Independent matched-hour summary:",
      {"matched_hours": int(summary["n"]),

       "ratio_range": (round(float(summary["min_ratio"]), 6), round(float(summary["max_ratio"]), 6))})
print("Independent bin counts and unrounded means:",
